preview.text: United Arab Emirates play Oman at ICC Academy Ground. In 14 recorded one-day meetings, United Arab Emirates have won 7 and Oman 6. United Arab Emirates won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours gives up to a 0 per cent chance of rain, at about 30 degrees.

summary.text: United Arab Emirates won by 4 wkts. OMAN made 196-10, Jatinder Singh top-scoring with 88 off 107 balls; Awais Ali Shah took 5 for 33. UAE made 199-6, Aryansh Sharma (wk) top-scoring with 49 off 61 balls; Samay Shrivastava took 3 for 27.
